parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `PlaycutMetadataMockCache.set` in `PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockCache.set` in `DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift` are test-only mock cache helpers. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and left alone. Here both records are test fixtures, making consolidation doubly inappropriate: merging them would couple two independent test suites and risk obscuring the distinct caching behaviours each test file is designed to exercise.
